meta.name: render-cosmic-mythology-voiceover
meta.description: Assemble a cosmic-mythology-voiceover reel from a config — a warm spoken voiceover carries the whole narrative while N curated cosmic stills are weighted beat-synced across the delivered VO duration (cut_dur = VO_dur times weight over the weight sum, so emotional beats hold longer), Ken-Burns-zoomed per still (scale 2x, center crop, zoompan, fade-in first and fade-out last), ffmpeg-concatenated, the VO composited under the picture (libx264 crf18 plus aac), the ONE on-screen hook line faded on over the open with a drawtext alpha window, and Whisper/VEED captions burned along the bottom — never in-world text on a still. This is the FREE deterministic assembly stage (weighted sequence plus Ken-Burns plus concat plus VO composite plus hook overlay plus caption burn); the VO and the stills come from create-vo-elevenlabs and create-image-fal. Use for the cosmic-mythology-voiceover format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将宇宙神话旁白与图片自动合成视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将旁白和图片自动合成为带字幕的视频
copy.tagline_en: Assemble cosmic mythology voiceover with images into video automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically combine voiceover and images into a captioned video

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据配置自动组装一段宇宙神话风格的配音短片：将一段温暖的人声配音与多张宇宙主题图片按节奏权重剪辑，每张图片做 Ken-Burns 缩放动画，合成视频并添加开场钩子文字和底部字幕。
howto.when: 当你提供配音音频、宇宙主题图片、每段剪辑的权重数组以及一句开场钩子文字时触发。

say.text: 帮我用这段配音和这些宇宙图片生成一个神话短片。
say.note: Claude 会按权重分配剪辑时长并合成视频。

say.text: 给这段配音配上权重：开场0.3，高潮0.5，结尾0.2。
say.note: 权重高的片段在视频中停留更久。

howto.what_en: Assembles a cosmic-mythology voiceover reel from a config: a warm spoken VO carries the narrative while N curated cosmic stills are weighted beat-synced across the VO duration, Ken-Burns-zoomed per still, ffmpeg-concatenated, with VO composite, hook overlay, and caption burn.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a spoken VO audio, cosmic still images, a weight array for each cut, and a hook line for the opening.

say_en.text: Generate a myth short with this VO and these cosmic images.
say_en.note: Claude will weight the cuts and assemble the video.

say_en.text: Set weights: intro 0.3, climax 0.5, outro 0.2 for this VO.
say_en.note: Higher weight means longer hold on that cut.
